how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-unknown-22.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:97246:obj:0: Visit Borstan's Firepit and tell him Thatog wants you to deliver Migi's lunch to him personally.
rows.quest:97246:details:0: My son, Migi, always takes off to play with his friends all day. I tell him to pick up a lunch at Borstan's, but I know he almost never does, because he comes home starving. These kids think their games are more important than their own bodies!
rows.quest:97246:details:1: Please, stop at Borstan's Firepit and tell him you're there to deliver Migi's lunch. You can almost certainly find Migi behind Grommash Hold with the rest of his friends.
rows.quest:97246:details:2: Duties keep me here during the day and I can't watch over his every meal.
rows.quest:97249:obj:0: Bring Migi's Lunch to him behind Grommash Hold.
rows.quest:97249:details:0: Now that I know his parents worry about how much he's actually filling that belly, I've got an idea.
rows.quest:97249:details:1: They made me promise not to pack the same meal every day, so Migi grows a taste for more than one thing. Still, whenever the smoker's full and we're making sweetglazed hog belly sandwiches, he always shows up for lunch. We've started crumbling the leftover crispy glazed bits as a topping--something we can add daily.
rows.quest:97249:details:2: Take this to him. Maybe he'll start showing up early and bringing friends!
rows.quest:97275:title: Whuut's the Rush
rows.quest:97275:details:0: Whuut is a prodigy. That much is true. But he doesn't yet have the experience, wisdom, and time on the stirring rod to know how to respect alchemical processes.
rows.quest:97275:details:1: He is exhausting all of the rarest and most exotic reagents we have available without pausing to practice and refine his basic skills.
rows.quest:97275:details:2: Give him this potion I've brewed with a quick tonic method. He'll reconsider everything he's doing when he learns how local remedies and careful touch are the first true mastery.
rows.quest:97275:completion:1: You say Yelmak made this potion from speargrass and cattail with no other reagents? I didn't know chemists had any real need for these common plants we see every day.
rows.quest:97275:completion:2: Maybe he's right. There could be a lot I'm missing out on by skipping to the most rare and least-studied flora first.
rows.quest:97275:completion:3: ⟦1⟧, take your pick from one of these potions I brewed earlier. I appreciate you taking the time to visit our shop.
rows.quest:97279:obj:0: Collect 6 Abandoned Training Weapons, then return to Kzan Thornslash in the Den.
rows.quest:97279:details:0: With an influx of new recruits like yourself, it's been hard to keep our weapons supplied. Our weaponsmith, Kzan, is running low on training weapons and I'd like to see what kinds of skills you possess to get an idea of what I have to work with. Luckily for you, I have a solution to both.
rows.quest:97279:details:1: While you're out there cutting your teeth on boars, salvage six abandoned training weapons. Our failed recruits left them laying on the ground. Once you do, return them to our weaponsmith Kzan behind me in the Den.
rows.quest:97287:obj:0: Speak with Archmage Celindra in the City of ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:97287:details:0: You have done well to infiltrate the city of mages, but I believe it is time for us to be more... negotiatory.
rows.quest:97287:details:1: As much as it pains me to admit, there is no other place on ⟦E3⟧ with such a vast knowledge of the arcane. My brilliant work still pales in comparison to the ancient wisdom the Kirin ⟦E4⟧ have amassed over the years. I think it's high time we are granted access to this exclusive order, don't you think?
rows.quest:97287:details:2: Take the mote you acquired. They will surely give anything to get it back. Anything.
rows.quest:97288:obj:0: Deliver the Abominable Head to Master Apothecary Faranell within the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:97288:details:0: <As the creature falls, its head comes toppling off. It seems as if it has been reattached several times, and the connection gets weaker with each reconnection.
rows.quest:97288:details:1: Someone in the ⟦E5⟧ would know more about this unique abomination.>
rows.quest:97289:obj:0: Bring the Head of the Baron to the body of Othmar in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:97289:details:0: We craft abomination heads all the time, but this one is special. It belonged to a Grand Marshal of the ⟦E6⟧ once. A particularly unpleasant one. Othmar, I believe its name was. The Dark Lady had the pleasure of dispatching this one herself.
rows.quest:97289:details:1: Ooh the secrets it could tell if it could talk. And it can! If we reattach it to an appropriate host.
rows.quest:97289:details:2: Go ahead and place it next to the available body in the next room. But don't attach it. Not yet.
rows.quest:97290:obj:0: Report your findings to Master Apothecary Faranell in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:97291:obj:0: Collect a Toxic Skullcap from Tawny Grisette in the Trade Quarter, Blisterweed near the ⟦E7⟧ Trainer, and Essence of Agony from the poison vendor in the Rogues' Quarter for Master Apothecary Faranell in ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:97291:details:0: With the head reattached, all we need now is to bind it to the Dark Lady's will. This should not be a problem. The beast barely has brains left as it is after all the beatings it's taken.
rows.quest:97291:details:1: We simply need to motivate it.
rows.quest:97291:details:2: Fetch me a Toxic Skullcap from Miss Grisette in the Trade Quarter. Oh, and some Blisterweed from our local herbalist trainers, the Alliestars. Feel free to just take some, they owe me. And lastly a bit of Essence of Agony. Any old poison vendor should do.
rows.quest:97291:details:3: We have a potion to make!
rows.quest:97292:obj:0: Inject the Hissing Serum into the system above Othmar's body for Master Apothecary Faranell.
rows.quest:97292:details:0: I have concocted a lovely serum that our new guest is sure to find quite... stimulating.
rows.quest:97292:details:1: Take this. Feed it into the workings dripping from above him. Let's see if we can't show him why it's in his best interest to serve loyally.
rows.quest:97292:details:2: And try not to drop it. I can't afford a new assistant.
rows.quest:97326:obj:0: Return 8 Smooth Boulders to Thra behind Grommash Hold.
rows.quest:97326:details:0: Hey! You've got time to help us out! I know you do, I can tell by the way you smiled watching the game we're playing.
rows.quest:97326:details:1: This spot behind Grommash Hold is nice because it's clear enough for us to set up our figures. But what stinks is we don't have enough rocks for chairs or tables.
rows.quest:97326:details:2: You're big and strong... d'ya think you could carry back some medium-sized rocks, smooth enough to sit on if we need a rest?
rows.quest:97558:obj:0: Bring Shelene Rhobart 8 Duskbat Wing Membranes, 6 Darkhound Hides and 3 Vile Fin Murloc Skin.
rows.quest:97558:details:0: One part of undeath no one mentions is what happens when we are injured. How does the skin of an undead heal itself?
rows.quest:97558:details:2: Ours is a cursed life, . We must take from the living to further our own existence.
rows.quest:97558:details:3: When we sustain an injury, we must replace our skin which usually means animal hides. Since different hide thicknesses are better for different places on our bodies a variety is key!
rows.quest:97558:details:4: Bring me wing membranes of a duskbat, hides from a darkhound and skin of a Vile Fin murloc.
rows.quest:97891:obj:0: Bring the Unstable Potion to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium within the time limit.
rows.quest:97891:details:0: You! Quickly, I need you to bring this potion across the slime canal to Doctor Martin Felben in the Apothecarium!
rows.quest:97891:details:1: It has a very limited shelf life, and no I can't go myself, my knees rattle and pop out if I attempt to run.
rows.quest:97891:details:2: Just another lovely side effect of undeath, apparently.
rows.quest:97891:details:3: But we're wasting time! Here, take this and go!
rows.quest:97985:obj:0: Slay Stormheart in and acquire its heart.
rows.quest:97985:details:0: Fascinating, aren't they? This is the first time I have ever been privy to the secrets of abomination creation.
rows.quest:97985:details:1: I have been studying these notes, and it appears we need a heart. A massive one!
rows.quest:97985:details:2: I hear there is a thunder lizard there of impressive size called Stormheart, that patrols along the canyon edge in ⟦E8⟧. With a name like that it must have the perfect heart. I must have that heart!
rows.quest:97985:details:3: Oh, also I suggest you bring friends. Stormheart isn't known for being docile.
rows.quest:98190:obj:0: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in ⟦E9⟧ Keep.
rows.quest:98190:details:0: You'll want to take this to ⟦E9⟧ right away. Proud as I am that this keep and harbor bears King Terenas Menethil II's name, we are a calm harbor in a very nasty storm of enemies. It's just not safe here.
rows.quest:98190:details:1: The Dragonmaw in particular would sacrifice much to loot something like this... and I shudder to think of what they'd do with it.
rows.quest:98190:details:2: Don't bother going up the chain of command on this one, . Go straight to Highlord Fordragon with this. He'll know where it will be best kept.
rows.quest:98191:obj:0: Bring the Menethil Statuette to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral of Light.
rows.quest:98191:details:0: King Terenas was a good man. A devout man. Beloved by his people, and truly the reason we have this ⟦E6⟧ at all.
rows.quest:98191:details:1: The irony is he was humble--he hated these sorts of memorials, and so precious few exist. And of those, few survived Lordaeron's fall.
rows.quest:98191:details:2: It seems the Light has coalesced in this statuette. It would be best kept in the Cathedral of the Light in Cathdral Square, in the center of the city. Bring it to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker for safekeeping.
rows.quest:98362:obj:0: Return to ⟦E10⟧ and speak with Turak Runetotem on the Elder Rise.
rows.quest:98362:details:0: The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Turak Runetotem, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.
rows.quest:98362:details:1: Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
rows.quest:98389:obj:0: Free 6 Webbed Victims in Night's Web Hollow for Aramis Hammerhand in Deathknell.
rows.quest:98389:details:0: If you remember but one thing, know this: not even death can stop the Light.
rows.quest:98389:details:1: This we have in common with all ⟦E11⟧--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.
rows.quest:98389:details:2: In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but we are not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
rows.quest:98389:details:3: Then they will see our nature.
rows.quest:98397:obj:0: Return to ⟦E12⟧ and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.
rows.quest:98397:details:0: The time has come for us to part ways once again, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me. It would seem your instructor, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, has found a worthy pupil in you. I believe I see one as well. Heed his lessons and you shall soon be able to draw upon the Great Cat Spirit to take its shape.
rows.quest:98397:details:1: Go back to whence you came. When the time is right, we will meet again.
rows.quest:98423:obj:0: Deliver the Treaty of ⟦E13⟧ to Magni Bronzebeard in ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:98423:details:0: Inside of the vault you find a tablet detailing the terms of a peace treaty between the Bronzebeard and Wildhammer dwarf clans. It appears to date back to time period just after the War of the Three Hammers, and is very likely a notable piece of dwarven history. The king of ⟦E14⟧ would no doubt be interested in this artifact.
rows.quest:98545:title: Leonid's Letter
rows.quest:98545:obj:0: Deliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the ⟦E5⟧.
rows.quest:98545:details:0: Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the ⟦E5⟧. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.
rows.quest:98545:details:1: You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the ⟦E5⟧. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.
rows.quest:98545:details:2: <Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>
rows.quest:98545:completion:1: Wait... he said I'd tip you? I didn't agree to that!
rows.quest:98545:completion:2: Fine. Take your pick of this junk in the lost and found. You'd be surprised how many of these ⟦E11⟧ leave their stuff laying around after getting haircuts. There's a joke here about them being brainless, but I suspect in a lot of cases it might actually be true.
rows.quest:98576:obj:0: Read the Glyphic Parchment and speak with Mai'ah near the entrance to the Den in the Valley of Trials.
rows.quest:98576:details:0: Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, .
rows.quest:98576:details:1: Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the mage trainer Mai'ah. She would have words with you when you're ready.
rows.quest:98601:obj:0: Read the Consecrated Scroll and speak to Aramis Hammerhand in the church in Deathknell.
rows.quest:98601:details:0: While you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. It reeks of the light, so I imagine its of some importance to a paladin like yourself.
rows.quest:98601:details:1: Read it before heading out again. Just please--step away when you do. Paladins make me quite uneasy.
rows.quest:98815:obj:0: Return 4 Thicket ⟦E15⟧ Hides to James Halloran, the tanner, in Menethil ⟦E16⟧.
rows.quest:98815:details:0: The Highlands are host to ruins of some sort, secrets now being explored by an expedition team. What I know is that they've got their own wildlife and beasts lurking in that mountain marshland. How about you take a foray in there with some well-equipped friends, and we work a trade?
rows.quest:98815:details:1: I don't care if they're hiding, I want their hides! Bring me the skins from four of the Thicket Raptors, I'll have a trade worked out for you to make it worth it.
rows.quest:98823:obj:0: Bring the Titan Relic to Muln Earthfury at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:98823:details:0: Truly, this is a fascinating object.
rows.quest:98823:details:1: It shows indications of being much more than a mere carving or sculpture.
rows.quest:98823:details:2: While our elders may be interested in observing this artifact, the ⟦E18⟧ are who would carry the most wisdom for our buried ruins and forgotten lands. Seek out Muln Earthfury, a direct approach is fitting for the gravity of what you carry.
rows.quest:98823:details:3: You can find him and other elders of the ⟦E18⟧ council at the Skywatcher Plateau in northwest ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:98824:obj:0: Bring the Titan Relic to High Explorer Magellas in ⟦E14⟧'s Hall of Explorers.
rows.quest:98824:details:0: With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than ⟦E14⟧'s Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.
rows.quest:98824:details:1: I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by ! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.
rows.quest:98824:details:2: High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.
rows.quest:99048:obj:0: Find Heglan Shadeeye north of Tiragarde Keep.
rows.quest:99048:details:0: A member of the Shattered Hand, a group of more... subtle fighters, was watching Tiragarde Keep from a distance. Her reports suddenly stopped coming in.
rows.quest:99048:details:1: I doubt the humans would have caught her, so I'm concerned something more dangerous is at play. See if you can find her. Hopefully the messages are just delayed.
rows.quest:99123:obj:0: Help Pal'juh escape Kolkar Crag and bring news of your success to Master Vornal in Sen'jin Village.
rows.quest:99123:details:0: I decided to do a bit of scouting in the crag on my own. Unfortunately my magic ran out at the wrong time and I've been stuck hiding here since.
rows.quest:99123:details:1: If you could help me escape, I would appreciate it.
rows.quest:99134:details:0: You are not a member of the Deathguard, and therefore have yet to disappoint me.
rows.quest:99134:details:1: As a reward for your lack of incompetence, you shall be rewarded with punishing those that have demonstrated such talents in excess.
rows.quest:99134:details:2: Swiftly now--, is it?--or I shall add your name to my ledger for someone else's reward.
rows.quest:99141:obj:0: Obtain reports from Deathguard Dillinger, Deathguard Kristof, and Gordo for Executor Zygand.
rows.quest:99141:details:0: Make no mistake, --the Dark Lady demands the perfect execution of her will. As an Executor, it is my duty to see that this happens.
rows.quest:99141:details:1: Reports from several of my Deathguards are overdue. Needless to say, my patience has run out. Obtain their reports and bring them to me in the Dark Lady's name.
rows.quest:99141:details:2: You will find Deathguard Dillinger just west of here, by the graveyard. Deathguard Kristof is stationed at the waystation to the east. And check on the abomination Gordo; he wanders west near Stillwater Pond.
rows.quest:99142:obj:0: Collect 5 Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
rows.quest:99142:details:0: If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.
rows.quest:99142:details:1: As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.
rows.quest:99142:details:2: Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
rows.quest:99144:obj:0: Help Bareth Dawnstone escape Crusader's Outpost, and report his safety to Shari Stilwell in ⟦E19⟧.
rows.quest:99144:obj:1: * Escore Bareth Dawnstone out of Crusader's Outpost
rows.quest:99144:details:0: Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in ⟦E19⟧ when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... all I strive to protect!
rows.quest:99144:details:1: I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.
rows.quest:99152:title: As Above, So Below
rows.quest:99152:obj:0: Collect 6 Faintly Glowing Bones for Hilda the Breaker.
rows.quest:99152:details:0: While the Tarnished in Shadowvale to the southwest are definitely a problem, we cannot allow the cellars below the town to fester into a full-blown Scourge uprising on Bandarion Keep.
rows.quest:99152:details:1: I need to get these trainees up to snuff in case that happens. You, however, are going to receive what I like to call a crash course.
rows.quest:99152:details:2: ⟦E20⟧ beneath Shadowvale and retrieve some of their wretched bones so we can study them further. I need ones that still retain some of the initial reanimation magic--that's glowing ones.
rows.quest:99152:completion:0: Well done, recruit. We might just make something out of you yet.
rows.quest:99152:completion:1: With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
rows.quest:99153:obj:0: Find the Hidden Crystal Fragment beneath Shadowvale for Ephram Barbaro.
rows.quest:99153:details:0: Oi, you! Word travels quickly among our ranks. I heard about the work you did with the cultists around the remnants of the battle with ⟦E21⟧.
rows.quest:99153:details:1: Problem is, one of them cultists got away with a piece of the focusing crystal. Seems to still have some juice in it. Best guess we have is it's somewhere beneath Shadowvale. It's either raising 'em or making 'em stronger, and you don't want either one.
rows.quest:99153:details:2: Find that crystal before this gets out of hand.
rows.quest:99156:obj:0: Bring Riptear's Heart to Deathguard Linnea.
rows.quest:99156:details:0: Damn it all! A new report came in while you were on patrol. There has been a sighting of a rogue abomination wandering Eastern ⟦E22⟧, near Venomweb Vale.
rows.quest:99156:details:1: Something is wrong. Abominations don't just slip through the Bulwark unnoticed.
rows.quest:99156:details:2: Keep this matter on a strictly need-to-know basis. That said, such a creature will not fall easily; you will need allies if you wish to be more than its next meal.
rows.quest:99156:details:3: See this through, and you will be duly rewarded. Bring me its heart as proof of the deed.
